y-m-74-05.title: Kana tikashandisa chimiro chimwe zvakare, tinoda mifananidzo yakawanda zvakadini zvakare?
y-m-74-05.goal: Simbisa kuti kana huwandu hwezvimiro huchikura, huwandu hwemasero akaparadzaniswa hunokura nokuwanza saka data rimwe chete haringazadzi masero, uye gadzira zvirongwa zvakati wandei zvinosangana namamiriro uye upe zvikonzero.
y-m-74-05.material:
Kirabhu iri kugadzira AI inorongedza michero mumifananidzo. Mifananidzo yokudzidzisa iripo ndi 2,000. Kukosha kunoyerwa kubva pamufananidzo (zvinhu zvinoratidzwa senhamba, se huremu, kujeka kweruvara, kureba) kunonzi 'zvimiro'. Chikwata chinosarudza zvimiro d, chinoparadzanisa kukosha kwechimiro chega chega kuva mhando b, wobva wagadzira masero nokuita mapeya emhando rimwe nerimwe. Huwandu hwemasero ndi b yakawanzwa nguva d (b^d, 'b kusimba rechi d'). Semuenzaniso, kana b = 5 ne d = 3, saka 5×5×5 = 125 masero.
Chibvumirano: sero rega rega rinofanira kuva nemifananidzo 5 kana kupfuura paavhareji kuti tivimbe kutonga kwesero iroro. Fungidzira kuti mifananidzo yakapararira zvakaenzana mumasero.

y-m-74-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukachengeta huwandu hwemhando b = 5 uye ukawedzera zvimiro kubva pa 3 kuenda ku 4, chii chinoitika kuhuwandu hwemasero?

y-m-74-05.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti mhando dzechimiro chitsva dzinoitwa mapeya sei nesero rega rega rakatovapo.
y-m-74-05.s.s1.o.a: Chimiro chimwe chinowedzerwa, saka masero anowedzera ne 5, kusvika pamasero anenge 130.
y-m-74-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakatora kuwedzera chimiro sokuwedzera sero. Funga kuti mhando dzechimiro chitsva dzinoitwa mapeya sei nesero rega rega rakatovapo.

y-m-74-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti masero anokura nereshiyo yehuwandu hwezvimiro. Huwandu hwemasero hunosarudzwa nokuwanza huwandu hwemhando zvakadzokororwa, kwete zvichiwirirana nehuwandu hwezvimiro.

y-m-74-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga kuti huwandu hwemasero hahuna chokuita nehuwandu hwezvimiro. Dhirowa kuti nzira yokuparadzanisa inochinja sei kana ukashandisa chimiro chimwe zvakare.
y-m-74-05.s.s1.explain: Mu b^d, kuwedzera d kubva pa 3 kusvika pa 4 kunobva pa 5^3 = 125 kuenda pa 5^4 = 625, kukura nokuwanza kumwe zvakare nemhando 5 dzechimiro chitsva. Nemifananidzo 5 pasero, unoda 625 × 5 = 3,125 mifananidzo.

y-m-74-01.title: Kana Ukachinja Mayuniti, "Muchero Uri Padyo Zvikuru" Uchiri Wakafanana Here?
y-m-74-01.topic: Kuronga nemuvakidzani ari padyo zvikuru: dhuri nemayuniti
y-m-74-01.goal: Siyanisa nekuverenga kuti kana nhamba dzezvimiro zvese dzachinjwa neratio imwechete, "muvakidzani ari padyo zvikuru" anoramba akafanana, asi kana yuniti yechimiro chimwe chete ikachinjwa, inogona kuchinja, uye ududze mhedzisiro iyoyo sechinhu chekusarudza mayuniti.
y-m-74-01.material:
App yekuronga michero inoronga muchero mutsva se 'apple' kana 'pear'. Nzira i 'tevera muvakidzani ari padyo zvikuru'. Pakati pemichero ine mazita anozivikanwa, inowana muchero uri padyo zvikuru nemuchero mutsva nedhuri uye inopa muchero mutsva zita remuchero iwoyo.
Dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri (x1, y1) ne (x2, y2) rinoyerwa se √((x1−x2)²+(y1−y2)²). (√ inoverengwa 'root'.)
Michero ine mazita anozivikanwa (zvimiro zviviri: kurema [g], kutapira [nhamba mumayuniti e Brix; painonyanya kukura, ndipo painonyanya kutapira])
- Muchero P: apple, kurema 154g, kutapira 12
- Muchero R: pear, kurema 165g, kutapira 16
Muchero mutsva Q: kurema 172g, kutapira 12
Fungidziro: nhamba dzezvimiro zviviri dzinoiswa mukuverenga dhuri sezvadzakaita.

y-m-74-01.s.s1.prompt: Kana dhuri riyerwa nekurema mu g nekutapira se nhamba ye Brix sezvayakaita, Q icharonga sei?
y-m-74-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakaparadzana musiyano wekurema nemusiyano wekutapira kuna Q ne P, uye kuna Q ne R.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isa madhuri maviri padivi pedivi uye uenzanise kuti ndeipi iri diki.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.o.a: Haigone kuronga; kurema nekutapira zvine mayuniti akasiyana, saka dhuri haigone kuyerwa.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakacherekedza dambudziko rekusanganisa mitengo ine mayuniti akasiyana. Asi app inogona kuverenga nenhamba dzega, uye mushure mekuwana mhedzisiro iyoyo ndipo patinogona kubvunza kuti dambudziko rinobuda kupi.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.o.b: Pear; dhuri pakati pe Q ne R i pfupi kupfuura dhuri pakati pe Q ne P.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.r.b: Wakayera madhuri maviri zvakananga uye wakasarudza idiki. Iyi i mhedzisiro mu yuniti iyi.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.o.c: Apple; muchero P, une kutapira kwakafanana kwe 12, wakafanana zvikuru.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakaenzanisa kutapira chete. Dhuri rinofanira kuyerwa uchishandisa musiyano wekurema nemusiyano wekutapira pamwe chete.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.o.d: Apple; dhuri pakati pe Q ne P i pfupi kupfuura dhuri pakati pe Q ne R.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.r.d: Yera madhuri maviri zvakananga uye utarise zvakare kuti ndeipi iri diki. Painonyanya kudiki dhuri, ndipo painonyanya kuva padyo.
y-m-74-01.s.s1.explain: Dhuri pakati pe Q ne P i √(18²+0²)=18, uye dhuri pakati pe Q ne R i √(7²+4²)=√65≈8.1. Mu yuniti iyi R i padyo, saka Q inoronga se pear.

y-m-74-02.material:
'Kudzidza' mu AI model i basa rekuwana mutengo w apo loss (kukanganisa kwakadini) inova diki zvikuru. Loss mubasa iri i L(w) = (w−3)², saka i diki zvikuru, 0, kana w = 3.
Komputa inogadzirisa w seizvi.
w itsva = w yazvino − η × 2(w−3)
(η i learning rate, inoverengwa 'eta'. 2(w−3) i expression, yatopiwa, yekuti loss inochinja sei pa w yazvino. Unongoisa mitengo uye uverenge.)
w yekutanga i 0, uye η i hombe kupfuura 0. Hajun, shamwari yemukirabhu, akati, "Kana ndikaisa η hombe, ku 1, haizosvika nekukurumidza zvikuru kamwe chete here?"

y-m-74-03.goal: Tarisa nekuverenga kuti avhareji yenhamba dzakaiswa semalabels inochinja zvichienderana nemaitiro anopiwa nawo nhamba, saka haisi ruzivo nezve menu, uye unyore kuti chii chinofanira kutaurwa panzvimbo.
y-m-74-03.material:
App yechikoro inochengeta 'menu yemasikati inodiwa' senhamba. Gimbap = 1, ramyeon = 2, tteokbokki = 3, bibimbap = 4. Vadzidzi 8 vakapindura; 6 vakasarudza gimbap, 2 vakasarudza bibimbap, uye hapana mudzidzi akasarudza ramyeon kana tteokbokki. Scrini ye app inoratidza "Nhamba yepakati yemenu: 1.75".
Mumwe webasa rechikwata akati, "1.75 i pakati pe gimbap (1) ne ramyeon (2), saka vadzidzi vechikoro chedu vanoda gimbap kana ramyeon."

y-m-74-03.s.s2.prompt: Chengeta nhamba dzakachinjwa kuita gimbap = 4 ne bibimbap = 1 (ramyeon = 2 ne tteokbokki = 3 zvinoramba zvakafanana), uye wane avhareji zvakare kune vadzidzi vamwechete 8. Avhareji i chii?
y-m-74-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora nhamba dzinobatwa nevadzidzi 6 nenhamba dzinobatwa nevadzidzi 2.
y-m-74-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wawana huwandu hwenhamba 8 dzakachinjwa, uye uone kuti sei huwandu uhwo huchichinja.

y-m-74-03.s.s3.prompt: Avhareji yakachinja zvichienderana nemaitiro akapiwa nawo nhamba. Nyora, nezvikonzero, kuti chii uye sei zvinofanira kutaurwa kuzivisa kudiwa kwevadzidzi nenhamba mudata iri.

y-m-74-06.title: Ndiani anosarudza kuti vhidhiyo A kana B inotanga?
y-m-74-06.goal: Tarisa kuti muchiyero chinosanganisa zviratidzo zviviri kurongwa kunochinja nehuremu, taura kuti chii chimwe chinofanira kuzikanwa kusarudza kurongwa, uye gadzira huremu hwako umo A inouya mberi.
y-m-74-06.material:
Apu yemavhidhiyo inosarudza kuti vhidhiyo ipi pamaviri, A kana B, inoratidzwa kutanga nechiyero. Vhidhiyo yega yega ine zviyero zviviri (zvose kubva pa 0 kusvika pa 100).
- Vhidhiyo A: chikamu chakatariswa kusvika kumagumo (completion rate) 80, like rate 20
- Vhidhiyo B: completion rate 60, like rate 50
Chiyero = w1 × completion rate + w2 × like rate. w1 ne w2 huremu hunopiwa kuzviyero zviviri, zvose 0 kana kupfuura, ne w1 + w2 = 1. Vhidhiyo ine chiyero chakakwirira inouya kutanga.
Shamwari yechikwata Jia inoti, "B ine like rate yakakwirira zvikuru, saka zvirokwazvo B inotanga," uye shamwari yechikwata Doyun inoti, "A ine chikamu chakakwirira chakatariswa kusvika kumagumo, saka A inotanga."

y-m-74-10.material:
App yekutumira inoenzanisa mamodel A neB anofungidzira nguva yekusvika. Kumatumirwa 5 akafanana, musiyano pakati pekufungidzira nenguva chaiyo (kukanganisa; yuniti maminitsi; hukuru chete, pasina chiratidzo) ndeuyu.

- Model B: 1, 1, 1, 1, 9
Tinoenzanisa nezviyero zviviri. Hukuru hwekukanganisa kwepakati = avhareji yehukuru hwekukanganisa, mean square = avhareji yekukosha kunowanikwa nekuwanza kukanganisa kwega kwega kaviri. Kuzviyero zvose zviviri, kudiki, model iri nani.
Mumwe wechikwata anoti, "Hukuru hwekukanganisa kwepakati hweB hudiki, saka B iri nani."

Maitiro ekubatanidza impurity yeyese mushure mekupatsanura kuita mutengo mumwe i yako kuwana pakugadzirisa dambudziko.
